title: Prunify Scheme
description: A line-based output pruning scheme for prunify — defines rules to keep or discard lines from command output.

command.description: The shell command whose output this scheme prunes (e.g. "ls -la", "git status", "ps aux")

version.description: Schema version. Must be 1 (line-based selectors only; AST-based selectors are v2+).

rules.description: Ordered list of pruning rules applied sequentially. A line is included if no rule discards it.

action.description: "keep": drop lines that do NOT match the condition. "discard": drop lines that DO match the condition.

match_condition.description: The condition that determines which lines match this rule.

description.description: Optional human-readable explanation of what this rule does.

pattern.description: A regular expression to match against each line of output.

index.description: Zero-based column index in tabular output (whitespace-split).

pattern.description: A regular expression to match against the extracted column value.

lines.description: One or more 1-based line numbers to match.
